ext.description: AI-powered development flow moderator — orchestrates code quality, compliance, testing, and task routing via MCP Knowledge Server and n8n workflows. Works with any project.
chatParticipant.description: Development flow moderator — code quality, testing, compliance, estimation
cmd.test: Evaluate test strategy for a hook/file
cmd.quality: Assess code quality against platform standards
cmd.compliance: Check PR compliance against pinned ruleset
cmd.dirigent: Delegate a complex task to AISHA Dirigent Agent (n8n orchestration)
cmd.route: Route a task to a specific LLM model via Model Router (e.g. /route gemini …)
cmd.models: Show AI model registry — all tracked models across providers with status and metrics
cmd.eval: View or trigger AI evaluation runs (e.g. /eval trigger)
cmd.proposals: Show AI improvement proposals from the self-learning loop
cmd.health: Check platform health — backend connectivity, services status
cmd.status: Show platform status — connectivity, story context, workspace info
cmd.onboard: Auto-detect project context, recommend expert rules, and sync copilot-instructions.md
cmd.story: Discuss and refine project story — planning, scope, acceptance criteria, risks
cmd.stats: Show resource usage statistics — API calls, tokens, latency, estimated cost
config.expertiseLevel: Guidance profile — controls depth of decision support, context retention, and trade-off explanation
config.storyId: Default story UUID for project context (overridden by .aisha/story.json)
config.supabaseUrl: Backend API / Gateway URL (PostgREST-compatible) for push channel, context sync and RPC (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000 for local warmup or https://your-server). Legacy name kept for compatibility; points to the current AISHA stack, not Supabase.
config.bootstrapUrl: Instance bootstrap endpoint (e.g. https://api.aisha.guru/.well-known/app-config.json) used to auto-configure the rest.
config.keycloakUrl: Optional Keycloak realm URL override (usually provided by the bootstrap endpoint).
config.webUrl: Optional AISHA web frontend URL override (usually provided by the bootstrap endpoint).
config.orchestrationUrl: Optional human-facing orchestration endpoint override (usually provided by the bootstrap endpoint).
config.anonKey: Backend anon key — used for user authentication (login flow)
cmd.loginWithAishaId: AISHA Dirigent: Login with AISHA ID
config.dashboardUrl: URL for the AISHA dashboard (used in the embedded webview)
config.showUsageStats: Show resource usage footer after each AISHA response
config.showTokenCounter: Show token counter in the status bar
cmd.connectRepo: Link workspace GitHub repository to active story via GitHub App
cmd.local: Run a task on local edge model (recap, diff, filter) — requires edge-first mode
config.edgeFirst: Use local LLM models (Ollama/vLLM) for data collection, recap, and filtering tasks when available (opt-in)
walkthrough.title: Welcome to AISHA
walkthrough.description: Set up your development environment and connect to AISHA backend.
walkthrough.step.welcome.title: Welcome to AISHA Workbench
walkthrough.step.welcome.description: AISHA is your AI-powered development companion. Local-first, story-driven, always under your control.
walkthrough.step.detectEnv.title: Detect Your Environment
walkthrough.step.detectEnv.description: AISHA scans for local services — AISHA local stack (via npm run warmup:local or npm run setup), Docker, Ollama, n8n, LM Studio — and auto-configures connections.
walkthrough.step.connectBackend.title: Connect Backend
walkthrough.step.connectBackend.descript: Choose your backend: Local (run `npm run warmup:local` or `npm run setup` for the real AISHA stack with Keycloak + PostgREST), Self-hosted (your server), or AISHA environment.
walkthrough.step.signIn.title: Sign In
walkthrough.step.signIn.description: Log in with your credentials. Same account as the web app — one identity everywhere.
walkthrough.step.questionnaire.title: Tell Us About Yourself
walkthrough.step.questionnaire.descripti: Quick profile — role, AI experience, interests. AISHA adapts the environment to your needs. You can skip and fill later.
walkthrough.step.aiSetup.title: AI Models
walkthrough.step.aiSetup.description: Choose your AI: Ollama (local), Docker AI, LM Studio, or AISHA Cloud. Your data stays with you — local AI is the default.
walkthrough.step.selectStory.title: Select a Story
walkthrough.step.selectStory.description: Pick the story/project you're working on. AISHA loads context, rules, and knowledge for that story.
walkthrough.step.ready.title: All Set!
walkthrough.step.ready.description: Your environment is configured and AISHA is ready. Type @aisha in chat or open the Dashboard.
config.languageOverride: AISHA extension UI language. 'auto' follows VS Code display language.
